closePosition((address,address,uint24,in.details: Can be called by the recipient (msg.sender == recipient) or by an      authorized close executor (owner or designated bots).      Proceeds are credited to the recipient's claimable balance and can      be withdrawn via claimProceeds().

params.recipient: The address that should receive the close proceeds
params.solver: The solver who backed the position

params.orderId: Unique order identifier from the origin chain event.
params.originData: ABI-encoded SwapParams from the origin chain order.                    The solver address in originData is overwritten with address(this).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

rescueToken(address,address,uint256).details: Only for tokens that are NOT the position collateral/debt currencies.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claimProceeds(address).notice: Claim accumulated close proceeds for a given token.

closePosition((address,address,uint24,in.notice: Close a position opened by this settlement contract.

fill(bytes32,bytes,bytes).notice: Fill a cross-chain order on the destination chain.

rescueToken(address,address,uint256).notice: Emergency withdrawal of ERC-20 tokens NOT related to open positions.
